evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: rows 5-6 of strips are already bent at their base while rows 1-3 stay upright; by shot-08s the curl band crosses mid-frame, and by shot-20s the top rows curl while the bottom rows reopen, so the base-to-tip lag is visible.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: 48 strips of 12 nested segments each, with pale skin and fibre shading plus an ochre radial haze behind every strip; one rendering idea driven by keyframe delays, with no simulation or material change between frames.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream ground with an ochre and rust palette held consistently and clean strip silhouettes; by shot-20s the tightest curls show stair-step seams between segments on the inner face.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: a pine-cone scale bend-wave on an 8x6 grid appears in no anchor; the cream palette echoes anchor-04, but the base-first delay idea is distinct from every anchor shown.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the bend front is already visible at 2 s and shot-20s has a different composition with a cream margin; shot-08s repeats near-identical curled arcs across most of the grid, so the middle state reads as a stamp.

critique.change: At shot-08s, vary each strip's animation delay and curl amplitude by its column so the wave reads as a front crossing the grid instead of a repeated stamp of identical arcs.
Replace the flat radial ochre halos with a shared gradient or a per-strip tissue haze that brightens along the wave front, so the haze carries the mechanism rather than sitting as static blobs.
Remove the stair-step seams on tight curls at shot-20s by adding a segment overlap or a shading step on the inner face, so the end state reads as clean.
